tagline: Design and make a better world
hero_kpi_rationale: Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) is the primary growth and valuation driver at Autodesk, which has fully transitioned to a SaaS model, with over 90% of its revenue recurring and predictable.
company_description: Autodesk, Inc. engages in the provision of 3D design, engineering, and entertainment technology solutions worldwide. The company offers AutoCAD Civil 3D, a surveying, design, analysis, and documentation solution; Autodesk Build, a toolset for managing, sharing, and accessing project documents for streamlined workflows between the office, trailer, and jobsite; Revit, a software built for building information modeling to help professionals design, build, and maintain energy-efficient buildings; Autodesk BIM Collaborate Pro, cloud-based design collaboration and design management software; BuildingConnected, a SaaS preconstruction solution; and Tandem, a cloud-based platform that transforms the built asset lifecycle. It also provides AutoCAD software, a customizable and extensible CAD application for professional design, drafting, detailing, and visualization; AutoCAD LT, a drafting and detailing software; Fusion, a 3D CAD, computer-aided manufacturing, and computer-aided engineering tool; Inventor, a software solution that offers a set of tools for 3D mechanical design, simulation, analysis, tooling, visualization, and documentation; product design and manufacturing collection tools;

kpis.name: Subscription Revenue
kpis.explanation: Annual revenue generated from software subscriptions.
kpis.description: Autodesk derives over 93% of its revenue from subscriptions, ensuring high predictability and stable margins.
kpis.signal: Mature SaaS model with strong visibility

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue remaining after deducting direct costs.
kpis.description: High gross margin reflects the software nature of the business model, with minimal direct variable costs.
kpis.signal: Very high margin typical of SaaS software vendors

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin contracted slightly in FY2026 due to restructuring charges of $216M, impacting expected progression.
kpis.signal: Slight compression due to restructuring costs

kpis.name: R&D Investment (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue invested in research and development.
kpis.description: Autodesk continues to invest heavily in innovation, particularly in AI, cloud, and platform, with $1,643M in R&D expenses in FY2026.
kpis.signal: High R&D maintained for AI and platform innovation

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (cloud infrastructure)
kpis.explanation: Spending on physical or digital assets to support growth.
kpis.description: Investments are primarily directed toward cloud infrastructure and technology platform, representing approximately 5-6% of revenue.
kpis.signal: Moderate and stable Capex, focused on cloud infrastructure

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Headcount decreased slightly in FY2026, indicating rationalization and the impact of $216M in restructuring charges.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $7.206B in the latest fiscal year (FY2026).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $1.124B in the latest fiscal year (FY2026).

kpis.name: Percentage of cloud deals including AI features
kpis.explanation: Percentage of cloud deals that include AI and Autodesk AI capabilities.
kpis.description: Autodesk is increasingly integrating its Autodesk AI engine into cloud offerings, particularly in Fusion, Forma, and other applications, with Autodesk AI reflecting a decade of investment.
kpis.signal: Accelerating adoption of AI in design and manufacturing workflows

kpis.name: Fusion monthly active users
kpis.explanation: Number of monthly active users on the Fusion cloud platform for manufacturing.
kpis.description: Fusion, the core of the cloud manufacturing strategy, is seeing accelerating adoption driven by convergent generative design, simulation, and cloud capabilities.
kpis.signal: Strong growth of flagship cloud manufacturing platform

risks.title: Limited adoption of new products and services
risks.summary: The development of new products, particularly with generative AI and cloud offerings (Fusion, Forma, Flow), may not be adopted by customers, leading to losses on strategic investments.
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk in 10-K (Item 1A), mentioned in the introduction of risk factors with strong language on 'large expenditures' without guaranteed ROI. Critical for AI/cloud strategy. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Increased competition and technological disruption
risks.summary: The entry of new competitors and rapid technological changes, particularly in generative AI, threaten the competitiveness of Autodesk's product offerings and its market leadership position.
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly listed in summary of risk factors. Risk of market share loss and margin compression noted. Context: emergence of competing AI tools. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Dependence on international revenues
risks.summary: Geopolitical tensions, currency fluctuations, local regulations, and collection risks can significantly impact revenues outside the United States.
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly listed in risk factors. ~64% of revenue from international operations exposes the company to structural regulatory, monetary, political, and geopolitical risks. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Cybersecurity and data incident risks
risks.summary: A security breach or data violation could expose proprietary and customer data, severely damaging reputation and operational continuity.
risks.score_rationale: Enumerated in risk factors. For a SaaS/cloud company, data or IP compromise would be existential for reputation and operations. Risk increasing with cloud expansion. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Predictability of subscription renewal rates
risks.summary: Future revenue predictability heavily depends on subscription renewal rates, which are difficult to forecast precisely, affecting guidance and valuation.
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly listed in risk factors summary. Autodesk's SaaS model (93% of revenue) critically depends on renewal rates, which are hard to predict with precision. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Risks related to strategic acquisitions and integration
risks.summary: Strategic acquisitions (Payapps, simulation) carry integration risks, hidden costs, and operational disruptions that could affect margins.
risks.score_rationale: Listed as a major risk factor. MDA details acquisitions (Payapps FY2025, simulation FY2024) with explicit mention of integration costs and potential disruptions. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Increased regulation on data protection and compliance
risks.summary: The global expansion of data protection laws increases compliance and security costs and exposes the company to regulatory penalties.
risks.score_rationale: Global trend of tightening regulation (GDPR/CCPA/etc.) leading to rising compliance costs. Structural risk for multi-jurisdictional SaaS companies. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: Autodesk positions AI as a core capability of its platform (Autodesk AI), integrated across all products (Fusion, Forma, etc.) with nearly a decade of investment. AI is key to automating, augmenting, and analyzing customer workflows.
evidence: Autodesk AI mentioned as a ~10-year investment integrated into the platform
AI integration in Fusion (generative design), Forma, and cloud workflows
Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers integrated to standardize AI-enabled integrations
AI used for augmentation, automation, and analysis of customer workflows
35% of cloud deals now include AI features
